name: app.getrigged/clean
title: Rigged Clean
description: Clean the speech in a video. Every other stream comes back untouched.

tools.name: enhance_media
tools.description: Clean speech in a video or audio file. Submit a public HTTPS URL or a completed upload, then poll get_job if it is still running. For a keyless upload, pass upload_id and omit anonymous_session. Keyless requests preview the first minute. Paid jobs may spend credits. Omit idempotency_key for normal use. Rigged Clean reuses the job for the same source and options within 10 minutes under the same API key or anonymous session.

anonymous_session.description: Optional keyless session credential for grouping calls and retries. Omit it when submitting an anonymous upload by upload_id or reading an anonymous job by job_id.

source_url.description: Public HTTPS URL. Supply exactly one source.

upload_id.description: An upload ID whose PUT has completed. For an anonymous upload, the ID also authorizes submission. Supply exactly one source.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Omit for normal use. Rigged Clean deduplicates the same source and options for 10 minutes under the same API key or anonymous session. For explicit retries within 24 hours, reuse the same key with identical job parameters.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for a terminal state. Default 45 for submission, 0 for polling.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Read an existing job by job_id. For a keyless job, job_id is sufficient, so keep it private. Use the same API key for a keyed job. Optionally wait for a terminal state. A completed result includes the receipt and its download command.

anonymous_session.description: Optional keyless session credential for grouping calls and retries. Omit it when submitting an anonymous upload by upload_id or reading an anonymous job by job_id.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for a terminal state. Default 45 for submission, 0 for polling.

tools.name: create_upload
tools.description: Get a signed PUT for a local file. Upload exactly the declared byte count, then pass upload_id to enhance_media. For a keyless upload, upload_id is sufficient. Keep the ID and upload URL private.

anonymous_session.description: Optional keyless session credential for grouping calls and retries. Omit it when submitting an anonymous upload by upload_id or reading an anonymous job by job_id.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Read the credit balance, preview allowance and prices. With a pack and bearer key, return a checkout link for a person to open and approve payment.

anonymous_session.description: Optional keyless session credential for grouping calls and retries. Omit it when submitting an anonymous upload by upload_id or reading an anonymous job by job_id.
